name: planner
description: Plan-driven workflow: /plan-doc, /plan-code, /plan-clean, /plan-issues, /plan-commit. Review gates fail only on blocking findings; non-blocking ones are dispositioned and parked as out-of-scope issues. Split verdicts are resolved by a bilateral cross-lane dispute exchange in which each lane adjudicates the other's position, and a disputed finding falls only when both lanes object. Includes a Stop hook that enforces out-of-scope issue logging.
